_note: Slot spine v2 (Josh, 2026-10-17): 1 hero in light mode, 2-3 the top ASO features (custom sequences, the editor), 4 the Josh Approved card, then features in descending priority, an accessibility showcase (large text, captured with capture.mjs --font-scale 1.3 --cell store-<store>-large-text) and the dark-mode shot last (--appearance dark --cell store-<store>-dark). Captions are benefits, not labels. Android tablet (7"/10") screenshots intentionally omitted: FWT is portrait by design on Android (ScreenOrientation locks PORTRAIT_UP except during an active workout), so tablet shots can only duplicate the phone layout. Play shows the phone screenshots to tablet users, which matches the real layout. Apple/iPad is unaffected (its store separates iPhone/iPad by device tab).
